description: This file defines an abstract Scala class 'DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' that extends logging capabilities by allowing setting, deriving, and discarding correlation IDs and MDC entries for logging purposes. It provides an API for enhanced logging with contextual information, primarily used within the Eclipse Ditto project for Akka-based systems.
